rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a risky or daring undertaking.

example.english: Using all our savings to open a coffee shop is a real venture.
example.traditional: 用晒積蓄開間咖啡店，真係一場冒險。
example.jyutping: jung6 saai3 zik1 cuk1 hoi1 gaan1 gaa3 fe1 dim3 zan1 hai6 jat1 coeng4 mou6 him2

rows.note: Use this specifically for a daring journey or expedition of exploration.

example.english: We brought a compass for our rainforest venture.
example.traditional: 我哋入雨林探險，帶定指南針先。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jap6 jyu5 lam4 taam3 him2 daai2 ding6 zi2 naam4 zam1 sin1
